verdict.rationale: Unity's evidence covers asset import/version tracking (unity-docs-12, unity-docs-29), build automation/CI (unity-docs-28), and MCP/CLI-driven workflow automation (unity-probe-rt-1, unity-probe-rt-4), but nothing describes versioning, reviewing, or rolling back the automations/workflows themselves (e.g. AI Assistant prompts, MCP tool sequences, or CLI scripts) as a first-class capability. Missing for 10: no docs on automation history/diff view, no rollback mechanism for AI-driven workflows, no review/approval flow for automation changes.
